text:
ITEM 1 | Orange cube-shaped pieces, roughly 1.5 to 2.5 cm per side, with smooth, slightly glossy skin and a soft-looking, moist interior edge; some pieces show darker orange-brown caramelized or roasted edges and a few have slightly wrinkled surfaces; scattered in a loose cluster on the lower-center of a white square plate, about 10 pieces total covering roughly 15 percent of the plate surface | 110

ITEM 2 | Small dollop of bright red-orange glossy sauce or oil, about 1 cm across, sitting beside the orange cubes near the center of the cluster, with a wet, shiny sheen and no visible texture | 3

ITEM 3 | Pale off-white, crumbly to flaky mass with irregular rough edges and a slightly textured surface, sitting on a separate white plate at the far left edge of the image, partially cut off by the frame | 60
